key.name: toggle-system-actions
key.description: Keybinding to open/close the system actions popup.

key.name: panel-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the whole popup. 0 is fully transparent, 1 is solid. Fades every surface of the panel uniformly.

key.name: backdrop-dim
key.description: Darkness of the overlay behind the popup. 0 disables the dim entirely, 0.5 is the default shell look, 1 is the darkest.
